title: Geologic map of the Myrtle Beach quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2014, Geologic map of the Myrtle Beach quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-209, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; the map face is garbled. Units under an alloformation heading are associated with it from the layout and flagged inferred; symbols printed after descriptions likewise. Garbled symbols not recorded: 'QuHabf' (between beach sand and beach ridge sand), '[ aPtas |' (Ladson barrier deposits), 'OP' (Princess Anne estuarine). Corrected text-layer characters ('|' for 1, 'aFpas', 'Pamiico') are flagged inferred or noted. Bodies of water and disturbed ground not recorded as units. The sheet says its products are provided 'as is' without warranty.
SUBSURFACE: p. 1 gives the elevation range of each alloformation's seaward and landward margins (Silver Bluff 6-10 ft, Princess Anne 10-18 ft, Pamlico 17-25 ft, Ten Mile Hill 25-35 ft, Ladson 35-57 ft), stored as unit descriptions. Drill holes (e.g. 26-373) are plotted with SCGS log numbers but no depths; logs are on file at SCGS. No cross section or structure-contour map on this sheet. Datum: horizontal 1927 North American Datum, contour interval 2 meters; vertical datum for the elevations not stated.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; the map face is garbled). Units as before (units under an alloformation heading associated from the layout, flagged inferred); map symbols read from the legend boxes on page-image tiles, including those garbled in the OCR (QHabf, QPlds, QPpam). Alloformation margin elevations (Silver Bluff 6/10 ft, Princess Anne 10/18 ft, Pamlico 17/25 ft, Ten Mile Hill 25/35 ft, Ladson 35/57 ft, seaward/landward) are recorded as descriptions/contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Thicknesses with '|' for 1 flagged inferred. Whole-page image checked: no cross section or structure contours; SCGS drill holes (26-xxx) plotted by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS), so none is recorded. Bodies of water and disturbed ground not recorded as units.
